title: I Am Forever A Sacrifice
summary: The shabad does not leave comparison at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him
lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to the one who beholds, and inspires others to behold Him; by true actions, this human body is obtained, and the door within ourselves
source.lifeApplication: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Let this line guide the first honest return after the reaction.
